details.title: First line while editing
details.description: Placeholders: {file}, {language}, {project}, {branch}. Leave out what you don't want to share.

idleDetails.title: First line with no file open

idleState.title: Second line with no file open

privacyMode.title: Privacy mode
privacyMode.description: Show only the language: "Editing a Rust file in a project". No file, project or branch names, no repository button.

hideSensitiveFiles.title: Hide files that may hold secrets
hideSensitiveFiles.description: .env files, keys, certificates, keystores, Terraform state and variables, secrets.* and credentials.* files, and anything in .ssh, .aws, .gnupg or .kube are shown as "a private file", without their name or logo.

languageImages.title: Language logo
languageImages.description: Show the logo of the language, or of the tool for files such as package.json, build.gradle, vite.config.ts or GitHub workflows, with the OpenIDEA logo in the corner. Off, or with no logo: the OpenIDEA logo.

timestamp.title: Elapsed time
timestamp.description: session: since you started working (kept across windows and short breaks); file: since you opened the current file; none: no timer.

idleMinutes.title: Idle after this many minutes without editor activity (0: never)

idleAction.title: When idle
idleAction.description: clear: hide the activity; idle: show the idle line below with how long you have been away; keep: keep showing the last file.

idleText.title: Idle line
idleText.description: Shown when idle is chosen above. Placeholders as above.

resetTimerOnReturn.title: Restart the timer after being idle
resetTimerOnReturn.description: Off: the session timer continues after breaks shorter than 30 minutes.

repositoryButton.title: "View Repository" button
repositoryButton.description: Links to the project's git remote (origin), as an https address without user names or tokens. Others see the button; Discord doesn't show your own buttons to you.

customButtonLabel.title: Custom button label
customButtonLabel.description: Up to 32 characters. Discord shows at most two buttons: repository, custom, then OpenIDEA.
